fit.method: legacy least-squares fit of simulated turn-core endpoint to the median of three normalized no-contact video trajectories

audit.method: re-extract all indexed non-contact trajectories in the trajectory-start frame; fit endpoint separately from the 10..130 degree turn-core path
audit.interpretation: The endpoint-only, trajectory-start-corrected endpoint, and full-path fits disagree materially. No one coefficient is qualified as a swept-clearance trajectory model.

qualification.reason: The historical normalized trajectories do not support one angular-rate-proportional coefficient over the full swept path.
required_before_qualification: new repeated trajectories captured with absolute board-coordinate scene registration
label-height/parallax calibration or an uncertainty bound that covers it
a full-path model validated on held-out repeats and both required turn sides

limitations: This artifact is an empirical diagnostic, not a firmware execution parameter or a safety model.
The legacy K=0.03303 value fits one normalized core endpoint and must not qualify swept-clearance candidates.
Only right D135-in at 500 mm/s and alpha 10250 deg/s^2 was represented in the legacy endpoint fit.
The mirrored left turn, other speeds/alphas, and zero-entry regime are not validated.
Final acceptance uses the measured mini_r2_0 footprint and still requires repeated video with absolute scene registration.
